Outliers are unusual values in your data that stand out significantly because they're much higher or lower than the typical range. For Demand Fluctuation: Outliers are defined as a value more than 3 standard deviations away from the mean , except when Demand Deviation (average shift) is in the interval -0.5 to 0.5 (then it would not be considered an outlier). For Delivery Fluctuation: Outliers are based on the planned leadtime and the difference between the actual leadtime and the planned leadtime. For example, If the planned leadtime is 2 days then it is reasonable the delivery to be 4 days late (of course not good but not outlier), however if it is a day 0 flow it should never be for example 5 days late. It is considered an outlier if the delivery is late by more than this equation: Planned leadtime (days) * (2.2-(ln(planned leadtime (days))/3)​
